query.title: Heartbeat on realtime connections
query.description: Realtime connections exchange a heartbeat every thirty seconds.
query.body:
## Context

Silent dropped connections left users staring at stale data.

## Decision

We will send a heartbeat over every realtime connection every thirty seconds.

## Consequences

**Easier / gained:**
- One agreed answer.

**Harder / accepted trade-offs:**
